Title: Source 2: Seafood Paella
Content: Seafood paella is a rice dish that was first made in Spain. It was a favorite of people from the Canary Islands, a Spanish community off the coast of Africa. From `text(1778)` to `text(1783)`, about `text(two thousand)` Canary Islanders settled in Louisiana. The Canary Islanders kept many traditions and ways of life after moving to Louisiana, such as making seafood paella.
